# Warlock AI Openai

> Package: `@warlock.js/ai-openai`

> OpenAI SDK adapter for @warlock.js/ai

## Skills

- [Package orientation](@warlock.js/ai-openai/skills/index.md): Provider adapter for OpenAI and compatible gateways including Azure and OpenRouter in Warlock AI applications. Exports `OpenAISDK` with model and provider configuration for the shared AI contracts. Use when connecting this provider, configuring baseURL, reasoning, prompt caching, embeddings and image models, or diagnosing provider requests and usage. Read `setup-openai` for construction and examples using OPENAI_API_KEY. Not this package: agent loops, tools and workflows → @warlock.js/ai; HTTP and MCP tools → @warlock.js/ai-tools.
- [setup-openai](@warlock.js/ai-openai/setup-openai/SKILL.md): Wire @warlock.js/ai-openai — new OpenAISDK({apiKey, baseURL?, provider?, pricing?}) for OpenAI / Azure / OpenRouter, .model({name, vision?, reasoning?, structuredOutput?, responseFormat?, pdf?, audio?}) for ModelContract, .embedder({name, dimensions?}) for embeddings, .image({name, pricing?}) for gpt-image-*/dall-e-* image generation (via ai.image). PDF input maps to OpenAI file parts (opt-in pdf:true), audio input to input_audio (opt-in audio:true). Triggers: `providerOptions`, `OpenAICallOptions`, `countTokens`, `OpenAISDK`, `kimiSearchTool`, `kimiFetchTool`, `KIMI_SERVER_TOOL_PRICING`, `.model`, `.embedder`, `.image`, `.embed`, `.embedMany`, `baseURL`, `pricing`, `responseSchema`, `responseFormat`, `reasoning_effort`, `reasoningTokens`, `cachedTokens`, `cacheWriteTokens`, `inputIncludesCache`, `OPENAI_MODEL_PRICING`, `openAIPricingFor`, `ProviderOverloadedError`, `gpt-image`, `dall-e`, `ai.image`, `pdf input`, `input_audio`, o-series / gpt-5 reasoning, `api: "responses"`, Responses API, `ai.providerTool`, hosted `web_search`, `streamChunks`, `reasoning_content`, reasoning with tools, prompt caching; "wire openai into a warlock agent", "configure gpt-4o", "use o3 / gpt-5 reasoning effort", "route through openrouter or azure openai", "openai embeddings with warlock", "generate images with gpt-image / dall-e", "send a pdf / audio to gpt-4o"; typical import `import { OpenAISDK } from "@warlock.js/ai-openai"`. Skip: the ai.image verb surface — the `generate-images` topic of the `warlock-js-ai` skill; agent wiring — the `run-ai-agent` topic of the `warlock-js-ai` skill; adapter comparison — the `pick-ai-provider` topic of the `warlock-js-ai` skill; competing adapters `@warlock.js/ai-anthropic`, `@warlock.js/ai-bedrock`, `@warlock.js/ai-google`, `@warlock.js/ai-ollama`; raw `openai` SDK, Vercel `@ai-sdk/openai`.
